def factor_tail_asymmetry_intraday_jump_severity_ewm(df):
    """Downside vs upside intraday tail jump severity asymmetry with EWM aggregation for faster adaptation."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    vol = intraday_ret.rolling(63, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1).shift(1)
    threshold = 1.5 * vol
    vol_safe = vol.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    valid = vol > 0
    down_cond = (intraday_ret < -threshold) & valid
    up_cond = (intraday_ret > threshold) & valid
    down_sev = np.where(down_cond, (-(intraday_ret + threshold) / vol_safe).clip(lower=0.0), 0.0)
    up_sev = np.where(up_cond, ((intraday_ret - threshold) / vol_safe).clip(lower=0.0), 0.0)
    down_ewm = pd.Series(down_sev, index=df_copy.index).ewm(span=21, min_periods=10).mean()
    up_ewm = pd.Series(up_sev, index=df_copy.index).ewm(span=21, min_periods=10).mean()
    df_copy["factor_tail_asymmetry_intraday_jump_severity_ewm"] = -(down_ewm - up_ewm) / (down_ewm + up_ewm + 1.0)
    return df_copy["factor_tail_asymmetry_intraday_jump_severity_ewm"]
description: Mutation preserves the parent's core downside vs upside intraday tail jump severity asymmetry and uses the same active overnight/intraday decomposition tool. The bottleneck targeted is weak IC/ICIR caused by slow 63-day rolling-sum aggregation accumulating stale tail severity. The mutation replaces the 63-day rolling sum with exponentially weighted moving averages (span=21, min_periods=10) for both down and up severity before computing the bounded ratio. This reduces lag, downweights older tail events, and should produce a more responsive, linearly informative signal while retaining the downside-heavy ordering, bounded [-1,1] ratio, raw payoff stability, and RankICIR/payoff strength from the parent. Cross-sectional transform remains none because raw point-in-time asymmetry and monotonic payoff are the parent strengths to preserve.
